subject: MAP handoff & accelerated close runway — DPA / MSA / Order Form sequencing
messages:
From: Peter Cho <p.cho@helixtx.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Helix Therapeutics Legal <legal@helixtx.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + DPA timeline for pilot

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. Legal wants to make sure we have the evaluation gates and data handling mapped before we spin up the pilot.

Can you send a short mutual action plan that lays out: evaluation milestones, evidence we need to provide (SOC2/retention/audit logs), and the sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form so procurement can slot this into our June contracts sprint?

We kicked off our internal legal review and attached a short questionnaire to capture controls (attached: helix_evaluation_questions.pdf). Our procurement team is targeting signature by June 18th but can compress if the DPA review window is clear.

Primary ask: can Redwood commit to a DPA redline turnaround window (e.g., 2 business days for initial comments, 5 days for counter-signature) for pilot/order form items? If you can share a MAP draft with the timeline we can align resources.

Thanks,
Peter
Peter Cho
Senior Procurement Manager, Helix Therapeutics
attachments: helix_evaluation_questions.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Peter Cho <p.cho@helixtx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + DPA timeline for pilot

Peter — thanks for the note and for sending the questionnaire. Attached is a first-pass MAP that ties evaluation milestones to legal/procurement dependencies (MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx).

High level:
- Week 0 (kickoff): exchange questionnaire + security addendum.
- Week 1–2: evaluation run and acceptance tests (we'll provide telemetry and sample KV retention plan).
- Week 2: MSA + DPA review window (proposed Redwood turnaround: 2 BDs for initial redlines).
- Week 3: order form finalization and signature (we recommend DocuSign).

I've looped Marcus (CS lead) for onboarding sequencing and Karthik for DPA redline/clauses. Marissa will own procurement cadence and PO onboarding.

Action items I propose we track now:
1) Helix returns completed questionnaire by Thu (6/3).
2) Redwood posts MAP v1 and DPA redline summary by Tue (6/1).
3) Legal-to-legal call if Helix has major redlines (we can schedule Wed 6/2).

Attachments: MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | grace_oconnor@redwood.com
attachments: MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Cho <p.cho@helixtx.com>, Helix Therapeutics Legal <legal@helixtx.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + DPA timeline for pilot

Looping in legal comments so everyone has visibility. Quick summary of what we need to lock in now to avoid last-minute blockers:

1) DPA redline cadence: Redwood is prepared to review initial redlines within 2 business days if they are limited to standard data processing clauses. Complex redlines (new carve-outs or export controls) may require up to 5 BDs and an internal security review.
2) MSA signature authority: to speed things up, Redwood can accept an order form under our standard MSA; for any commercial deviations >15% list price we need approvals (we can fast-track but need 48 hours).
3) Order form dependencies: pricing, seat counts, retention tier, and billing contact must be final before signature. Procurement should confirm PO lead time and any EDI needs now.
4) Acceptance criteria: propose a short set of acceptance tests (attached: redline_summary_dpa.docx) that map to the MAP milestones — includes telemetry export examples and retention table.

If Helix legal can return a prioritized list of redlines (critical vs nice-to-have), we will triage and route to the right SME. Suggest legal-to-legal call Thu 6/3 or Fri 6/4.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance | Redwood Inference
attachments: redline_summary_dpa.docx

From: Peter Cho <p.cho@helixtx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix Therapeutics Legal <legal@helixtx.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + DPA timeline for pilot

Karthik — appreciate the clarity. A couple of Helix asks to note:
- We will prioritize the DPA carve-outs: data residency + subprocessors + breach notification timelines. We can flag those as critical and everything else as lower priority.
- For the pilot we need a 60-day termination right with data return/secure deletion options; can Redwood accept that for a timeboxed evaluation? If not, propose language that limits risk to both sides.
- Procurement confirms PO lead time of ~7 business days after signature; we want the order form/DocuSign envelope to be ready so we can route immediately upon countersignature.

We agree to return a prioritized redline list by EOD 6/4. Also confirm: do you need any additional evidence (audit logs/SOC artifacts) to speed security review?

Thanks,
Peter
attachments: none

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Peter Cho <p.cho@helixtx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + DPA timeline for pilot

Thanks all — quick running summary and next steps so procurement has a single source of truth:

Summary:
- Helix to return completed questionnaire + prioritized redlines by EOD 6/4 (Helix confirmed).
- Redwood commits to 2 BDs for initial DPA redline response for standard clauses; complex items may take up to 5 BDs and will be escalated.
- Redwood can accommodate a timeboxed 60-day termination for the pilot with standard data return and secure deletion language — Karthik will propose exact wording next business day.
- Order form will be prepared and staged in DocuSign; Marissa will own envelope readiness (Marissa: please create and pre-fill fields once pricing is confirmed).

Immediate action items:
1) Helix: send completed questionnaire + prioritized redlines — Peter to confirm via reply.
2) Marissa: create DocuSign envelope template and pre-fill typical order form fields (pricing, billing contact).
3) Karthik: draft pilot termination clause and data return language, circulate to Helix legal.
4) Marcus: prepare onboarding runbook and sample telemetry export for acceptance tests.

I'll put this MAP version into the shared HubSpot record and attach the MAP + redline summary there. If all goes to plan we should be able to hit signature target in a two-week compressed runway.

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | grace_oconnor@redwood.com
attachments: MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx, redline_summary_dpa.docx
